summary_en: HIDAY HIDAKA raised interim dividend by 2 yen to 28 yen per share effective November 6, 2026, and revised FY2027 final dividend forecast upward by 2 yen to 28 yen per share, bringing annual dividend to 56 yen.
title_en: Notice regarding dividend payment (interim dividend) and revision of final dividend forecast for fiscal year ending February 2027 (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief:
HIDAY HIDAKA resolved on October 2, 2026 to increase its interim dividend for the fiscal year ending February 2027. The interim dividend per share was raised by 2 yen from the previous forecast to 28 yen, with a record date of August 31, 2026 and an effective date of November 6, 2026. The company simultaneously revised its final dividend forecast upward by 2 yen to 28 yen per share, bringing the total annual dividend per share to 56 yen compared to the prior forecast of 52 yen.

The company stated that it pursues long-term and stable dividend payments to reward shareholder support, while maintaining an appropriate level of internal reserves to fund future capital expenditures for new store openings and to prepare for unforeseen business risks. The dividend increase reflects both this basic policy and current operating performance trends.
